title: Bank transactions
deleteMessage: The bank transaction is permanently deleted.

csvHelp.label: About the CSV file
csvHelp.title: Transaction report from the bank
csvHelp.source: Export a Transaktionsrapport as CSV from the section's business account in Swedbank/Sparbanken.
csvHelp.format: Upload the file exactly as it comes. Columns are read by position (Radnr … Belopp), so a file reordered or re-saved in Excel is read wrongly.
csvHelp.cards: A card purchase is tied to its card by a trailing K#### in Referens. Card numbers not seen before are added under Sektionskort automatically.
csvHelp.duplicates: Rows already imported are skipped. Upload the same file again and you get no duplicates.
csvHelp.limits: Maximum 5 MB. The character encoding (Windows-1252) is handled for you.
